structured.reason: The description contains hedged and conditional performance language, which the criterion treats as negative. "With regular use, your hair can appear thicker" hedges the product's effect ("can") and makes it conditional on usage ("With regular use"). "Apply it after shampooing to help fine hair look more voluminous" and "helping them appear thicker" also soften the claim with "help," which reads as a mild hedge. The remaining sentences are neutral specs or plain positives, but the hedged performance claims are enough to fail under the strict standard.
